items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was raised mostly by my mother, cause my father sort of disappeared when I was about a year old.

ctx.x: And I don’t remember that wonderful experience, cause I was an infant. I was raised mostly by my mother, cause my father sort of disappeared when I was about a year old. He didn’t disappear; he was put away from our household by my mother, cause she found him canoodling with someone else.
Can we get your mother’s name, full name?
